title: Untitled Smp
description: A Minecraft Cracked Server With Alot Of Custom Enchantments
body:
Untitled SMP

Untitled SMP is a survival Minecraft server where players have the freedom to play however they want. Build, explore, team up, or go solo in a world with extra features and fewer restrictions.

Features

✨ Custom Enchantments
Find powerful and unique enchantments that add new abilities and make survival more exciting.

🏠 /home Command
Set your home and teleport back to your base anytime.

📨 /tpa Command
Teleport to friends and meet up quickly.

🌍 Survival SMP Gameplay
Build bases, explore the world, form teams, or compete with other players.

🔥 Griefing Allowed
This is a more chaotic survival experience—raiding and griefing are allowed, so protect your base and stay alert.

Join the Adventure

If you enjoy survival with fewer rules and more freedom, Untitled SMP is the place for you. Build your empire, defend your base, and see how long you can survive.
